verdict.rationale: Docs support agent mode editing files, autonomous background task execution, and skills for specialized tasks, which plausibly cover writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving conflicts, and updating dependencies, but no evidence pack item explicitly confirms these specific tasks (tests, lint, merge conflicts, dependency updates) working reliably.
